note: guards are slow/fast A/B ratios measured in one process against one data set: the machine cancels, so these are the real gate. fbm-octave-loop/shipped-vs-frozen-imperative is THE gate (tolerance 1.15) — it pins the shipped fbm2D against a frozen copy of its own current shape; array-from-reduce is the price list (tolerance 1.3).
